title: 第3章：与变异丧尸的鏖战！
slug: 丧尸爆发我的房车能无限升级
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

车顶上那人是个女的。

隔着两百米的距离和车灯的强光，林昊只能看到一个模糊的轮廓，头发散着，一只手拼命挥，另一只手死死扒着车顶行李架。

脚松开油门。

时速从九十掉到七十，六十。

系统探测自动触发，三个红点亮在微缩地图上。

两个在白色轿车左侧的护栏草丛里，一个在轿车正后方，距离那个蓝色人形标记不到五米。

三只丧尸，困兽之局。

林昊的脚悬在油门和刹车之间，两秒钟没动。

五颗晶核，一把防暴叉，储物空间塞得满满当当。

油够跑，水够喝，食物够撑三天。他现在的全部身家，勉强维持自己活着——勉强。

下车救人？三只丧尸散在暗处，草丛里的那两个根本看不清具体位置。

近战范围内被两只以上同时扑上来，防暴叉就是根烧火棍。

用车撞？白色轿车横在应急车道，空间不够他加速。

低速碾压要反复拉扯，万一车被卡住……

时速降到四十。

那个女人在喊什么，嗓子已经劈了，传过来的全是气音，一个字都听不清。

林昊的手在方向盘上拧了一下。

油门踩下去。

时速回到八十，九十。

房车从白色轿车旁边呼啸过去，气流掀起女人散乱的头发。

后视镜里她的手还举着，越来越小，越来越小。

高速公路拐了个弯，后视镜里什么都没有了。

林昊后槽牙咬得生疼。

不是不想救。

是救不了。

一个人、一辆破车、一把叉子，老天爷都救不了。

他把这个念头在脑子里滚了三遍，每滚一遍都觉得更像借口。

别想了。

系统面板拉出来，他开始清点家底。

食物：罐头、方便面、火腿肠、压缩饼干，够吃三天，省着点能撑四天。

饮用水二十瓶，够五天。

汽油，车里大半箱加三桶备用，总续航大约五百公里。

近战武器两件，防暴叉和橡胶警棍，远程武器……为零。

这是最大的窟窿。

收费站那三只丧尸用车碾过去了，服务区那七八只如果也是散的，还能碾。

但总不能永远靠碾。

车有损耗，当前已经7.5%，碾到三十只四十只，车壳子就快撑不住了。

必须找到远程武器。

物资探测的扫描结果还挂在面板右侧，梁溪服务区，前方十二公里。

物资信号“强”，橙色粗体字。

危险等级“中”，一闪一闪。

“中”比收费站的“低”高了一档，是橙色。

上次“低”是三只散丧尸，这次“中”会是多少？

面板弹出详细扫描报告，数据在加载，一行一行往外蹦……

【检测到移动目标约20个·标记为普通丧尸】

【检测到未知信号×1·标记为橙色·建议谨慎接近】

【橙色标记代表变异个体，战斗能力显著高于普通丧尸】

变异个体。

林昊把这四个字看了两遍，脑子里自动回放服务区女店员站起来的画面。

十几秒从人变丧尸，那已经够恐怖了。

变异体是什么？更快？更硬？更大？

不知道。

但那个“物资信号：强”同样扎眼。

强信号意味着大量未被搜刮的物资。

远程武器、升级材料、食物储备，可能全在里面。

不去，慢性等死。

去，可能是快速去死。

林昊的脚没离开油门。

时速稳定在八十五，路牌上的数字一个接一个往后退。

十公里，八公里，五公里。

服务区的建筑群出现在前方。

规模比之前那个大了两倍不止，主楼三层，带裙楼，左侧是加油站的顶棚骨架，右侧连着一个独立的汽修间。

停车场里横七竖八停着十几辆车，有的车门大开，有的撞在一起，一辆大巴歪在绿化带上，前挡风玻璃整块掉了。

林昊把车停在距离服务区入口三百米的匝道上，没熄火。

他盯着前方看了半分钟。

肉眼能看见四只丧尸在停车场里晃。走得漫无目的，撞上车了就换个方向继续走。

主楼一层的玻璃门碎了，黑洞洞的，里面看不清有什么。

二十只，系统显示的。

四只在外面，剩下十六只加一个变异体在建筑内部。

先清外围！……

林昊挂挡，车缓缓滑进停车场边缘。他把手按在方向盘中央，犹豫了一秒。

按下去。

“嘟————”

喇叭声在空旷的服务区炸开，刺耳，尖锐，能传出去至少五百米。

效果立竿见影。

停车场上那四只丧尸同时扭头，朝声源涌过来。

主楼碎掉的玻璃门里又钻出三只，跌跌撞撞跑出来，一只被门框绊了一跤，爬起来继续跑。

七只，全被引出来了。

Page (1/3)

The person on the roof of the car is a woman.

Between the distance of two hundred meters and the bright light of the car lights, Lin Hao could only see a vague outline, with his hair disheveled, waving desperately with one hand, and holding on to the roof rack with the other hand.

Take your foot off the accelerator.

The speed dropped from ninety to seventy to sixty.

The system detection is automatically triggered, and three red lights light up on the miniature map.

Two were in the grass on the guardrail on the left side of the white car, and one was directly behind the car, less than five meters away from the blue human-shaped mark.

Three zombies, a trapped beast.

Lin Hao's feet hung between the accelerator and the brake and did not move for two seconds.

Five crystal cores, a riot-proof fork, and the storage space is packed to the brim.

Enough fuel to run, enough water to drink, and enough food to last three days.With all his current net worth, he can barely keep himself alive - barely.

Get out of the car to save someone?Three zombies were scattered in the dark, and the two in the grass could not see their specific locations at all.

If two or more of them attack at the same time within melee range, the anti-riot fork will become a fire stick.

Hit with a car?The white car was lying across the emergency lane, and there was not enough room for him to accelerate.

When rolling at low speed, you need to pull repeatedly in case the car gets stuck...

The speed dropped to forty.

What was the woman shouting? Her throat was broken, and all that came through was breathy sounds, and she couldn't make out a word clearly.

Lin Hao twisted his hand on the steering wheel.

Press the accelerator.

The speed returned to eighty or ninety per hour.

The RV roared past the white car, and the air flow lifted the woman's disheveled hair.

In the rearview mirror, her hand was still raised, getting smaller and smaller.

The highway turned a corner and there was nothing in the rearview mirror.

Lin Hao clenched his back molars so hard that it hurt.

It’s not that I don’t want to save.

It can't be saved.

God can't save a person, a broken car, or a fork.

He ran this idea through his mind three times, and each time it seemed more like an excuse.

Don't think about it.

Pulling out the system panel, he began to inventory his belongings.

Food: canned food, instant noodles, ham sausages, compressed biscuits, enough for three days, save a little to last four days.

Twenty bottles of drinking water, enough for five days.

With half a tank of gasoline in the car and three barrels as spare, the total range is about 500 kilometers.

Two melee weapons, a riot fork and a rubber baton, and zero ranged weapons...

This is the biggest hole.

The three zombies at the toll station were crushed by the car, and the seven or eight zombies in the service area could still be crushed if they were also scattered.

But you can’t rely on crushing forever.

The car's wear and tear is currently at 7.5%. If it has been crushed by thirty or forty cars, the car's shell will no longer be able to hold on.

Ranged weapons must be found.

The scan results of material detection are still hanging on the right side of the panel, Liangxi Service Area, twelve kilometers ahead.

The material signal is "strong", in bold orange.

The danger level is "medium", flashing and flashing.

"Medium" is one level higher than "low" at the toll station and is orange.

The "low" last time was three scattered zombies. What will the "medium" be this time?

A detailed scan report pops up on the panel, and the data is loading, popping out line by line...

[About 20 moving targets detected and marked as ordinary zombies]

[Unknown signal detected × 1·Marked in orange·Recommended to approach with caution]

[The orange mark represents a mutated individual, whose combat ability is significantly higher than that of ordinary zombies]

Mutated individuals.

Lin Hao read these four words twice, and his mind automatically replayed the scene of the female clerk standing up in the service area.

Transforming from a human to a zombie in ten seconds is terrifying enough.

What are variants?Faster?Harder?Bigger?

have no idea.

But that "material signal: strong" is equally eye-catching.

A strong signal means a large amount of unplundered supplies.

Ranged weapons, upgrade materials, and food reserves may all be inside.

If you don't go, you will slowly wait to die.

Go, possibly die quickly.

Lin Hao's foot did not take off the accelerator.

The speed was steady at eighty-five, and the numbers on the road signs moved back one after another.

Ten kilometers, eight kilometers, five kilometers.

The building complex of the service area appears ahead.

The scale is more than twice as large as the previous one. The main building has three floors, with a podium. On the left is the roof frame of the gas station, and on the right is an independent auto repair room.

There were more than a dozen cars parked in the parking lot, some with their doors wide open, some bumping into each other, and a bus leaning on the green belt with its front windshield completely broken off.

Lin Hao parked the car on the ramp three hundred meters away from the entrance of the service area without turning off the engine.

He stared ahead for half a minute.

With the naked eye, four zombies could be seen wandering in the parking lot.I was walking aimlessly, and when I bumped into a car, I changed direction and continued walking.

The glass door on the first floor of the main building was broken, and it was so dark that it was hard to see what was inside.

Twenty, as shown by the system.

Four are outside, and the remaining sixteen plus one mutant are inside the building.

Clear the perimeter first!…

Lin Hao put the car into gear and the car slowly slid into the edge of the parking lot.He put his hand on the center of the steering wheel and hesitated for a second.

Press down.

“Du————”

The sound of the horn exploded in the empty service area, harsh and sharp, and could spread at least five hundred meters.

The results are immediate.

The four zombies in the parking lot turned their heads at the same time and rushed toward the source of the sound.

Three more emerged from the broken glass door of the main building and stumbled out. One tripped over the door frame and got up and continued running.

Seven of them were all lured out.
